state:
Goal `core-request-mount-and-1-more`: `Core\Request\Mount` has every proof, and its check is green.
`Core\Request\Part` has its class card, and `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` no longer names it.
Every `Part` member has its `covers:` markers on a Rust test and a `.nvst` case. `name`, `filename` and `contentType` share `a_files_walk_yields_the_file_parts_and_drains_what_it_passes`, which reads all three through `parts_of`.
`Core\Request\Part::content` and `Core\Request\Part::name` have every proof on disk and pass `bun nv proofs --verify`.
`readAll`, `saveTo`, `filename` and `contentType` still owe examples, an attack, a bench and `about.md`. They are all that stands between the goal and `dossier-core-request-part`.
A proof program that needs a request does not run under `bun nv try`. Run `target/covws/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/debug/nvs.exe run --request <case>.nvsr <case>.nvs` with `LLVM_PROFILE_FILE` pointed under `.agent-tmp/`.
A multipart part whose `Content-Disposition` names `name` twice throws a `ParseError` from the `files()` loop, so an attack that sends one catches it.
